item.title: Montana FWP Proposes New Cutthroat Protection Zones
item.description: The proposed regulations would close 14 miles of the Yellowstone River to protect native westslope cutthroat. Public comment period ends May 15. If you fish the Yellowstone, now is the time to make your voice heard at the FWP website.
